The [[Codru-Ji]] [[chief/Legends|chief]] [[Rikkar-Du]] had a '''camp''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]]. Rikkar Du's family, including his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Tassa]] and their [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] [[Jassar]], lived in a tent in the camp. In approximately [[137 ABY]], after a [[Codru-Ji clan leader meeting]], Rikkar-Du told Tassa to take Jassar back to camp while he visited a [[Temple (Munto Codru)|temple]] nearby.<ref name="Legacy 13" />
